entries.complaint: Every shower works differently; people can't tell which way is hot, how to switch tub to shower, or where the control is
entries.redesign: One control turns the shower on and off and a separate dial sets the temperature, marked in degrees with a blue-to-red gradient. The diverter is a clearly marked lever on the same plate. All controls sit near the door so they can be reached without stepping under the water
entries.prior_art: Thermostatic valves with degree scales (common in Japanese hotels)

entries.complaint: The fan sounds like it's working but doesn't remove moisture (it's undersized, has a clogged grille, or is switched off too soon), which leads to mold and peeling paint
entries.redesign: A built-in humidity sensor runs the fan until the room's humidity returns to normal, and an LED on the switch shows airflow as OK, weak (clean the grille) or blocked

entries.complaint: Older fans get loud (often around 4 sones), and parts loosen and rattle with age, so people avoid running them
entries.redesign: A 0.5 sone or quieter motor in rubber-isolated mounts with captive screws that can't vibrate loose; the motor swaps out from the room side without removing the housing

entries.complaint: Suction cups let go on textured tile and the caddy crashes down; wire caddies sold as rust-resistant rust within months
entries.redesign: Solid aluminum or plastic caddy with no welds, mounted by tension pole or adhesive plate rather than suction, with open slotted shelves that drain completely
entries.prior_art: Tension-pole caddies; powder-coated or aluminum caddies

entries.complaint: Water and toothpaste pool in the closed bottom of cup-style holders, turning into slime that is hard to reach and clean
entries.redesign: Open-bottom or wall-mounted holder that grips each brush by the neck so it hangs head-up with nothing beneath it to collect water, made of a single dishwasher-safe part

entries.complaint: The two bottles are nearly identical and labeled in tiny type, so without glasses in a dim shower people can't tell them apart
entries.redesign: An industry-wide tactile code (raised stripes for shampoo, dots for conditioner, plain for body wash) plus contrasting cap colors

entries.complaint: Pink slime and mildew grow in the damp folds of the liner, which then has to be washed or thrown away
entries.redesign: A quick-drying, machine-washable fabric liner on a rod that stays open so the liner hangs flat and dries without folds, with a removable weighted hem

entries.complaint: The liner billows inward and sticks to the person showering
entries.redesign: A weighted hem plus magnets placed where they meet a steel tub, sold standard on every liner, and a curved rod that pushes the liner outward
entries.prior_art: Weighted or magnetic liners; curved shower rods

entries.complaint: Swapping the roll on a spring-loaded rod takes two hands, and the spring fails or the arm falls off
entries.redesign: An open, single-arm holder the roll slides onto with one hand, with no spring or detachable rod

entries.complaint: Older low-flow models with narrow trapways clog and need double flushing (much less common with newer models)
entries.redesign: A wide trapway and glazed bowl as standard, with the independently tested flush score (MaP grams) printed on the box
